systems.platform: SPAQ application linked to a portable ultrasound scanner
systems.owner: UNFPA with the Guinean government, financed by Japan (USD 393,333); technology of SOIK Corporation
systems.tiers: planned: one mobile clinic and ten health structures (unnamed), 20 midwives trained; memorandum signed 16 June 2026

note: No hmis or emr system: the only system is SPAQ, an application tied to a portable ultrasound for antenatal follow-up, centralising results and remote monitoring (maternal programme only, with a telehealth element), planned under a memorandum signed 16 June 2026.
